_comment: Few-shot examples for the Accounts node's intent prompt (plan section 8). Loaded by com.hivecore.llm.FewShots.
Shape: {role, shots:[{question, answer}]}. answer is an IntentSet object: {intents:[{table, metric, column?, group_by?, filters?}]} or {not_relevant:true}.
Each shot becomes a user turn (the question) and an assistant turn (the answer re-encoded compactly). Keep exactly three; mined rows are added at runtime by the evening close.
Shot 1 shows a month-name filter in the demo year 2026 (month = substr(date,1,7) is derived at import). Shot 2 shows a status filter with the value as stored.
